The [[Dubravan]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]] ate a '''red fruit'''. Each piece of the fruit was round, and many examples had stems with leaves growing from them. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Dubravan [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nevana]] carried a basket of the fruit through a [[Unidentified town (Dubrava)|town]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], but she dropped it when a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] fired upon her.
